name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea for LocalWeb

**Your use case — what are you trying to build?**
Describe the *website* you're trying to make, not just the feature. e.g. "I'm making a page for my café and visitors need to see the menu on their phones."

**The problem**
What currently stops or slows you down?

**Your suggestion**
What should LocalWeb do instead?

**Scope check**
Have you read [docs/ROADMAP.md](/docs/ROADMAP.md)? Some things (forms, cloud sync, custom CSS) are deliberately parked for v1 — knowing that up front saves everyone time. 🙂
